segments.ja400:1.3: Mahā me gahito [rohito (ka.)] maccho, so maṃ harati vegasā.
segments.ja400:2.3: Ahaṃ taṃ uddharissāmi, supaṇṇo uragāmiva [uragammiva (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja400:3.1: Vivādo no samuppanno, dabbhapuppha suṇohi me;
segments.ja400:4.1: Dhammaṭṭhohaṃ pure āsiṃ, bahū aḍḍā me tīritā [bahuaṭṭaṃ me tīritaṃ (sī.), bahuaṭṭaṃva tīritaṃ (syā.), bahu atthaṃ me tīritaṃ (pī.)];
segments.ja400:5.3: Accāyaṃ [athāyaṃ (sī. pī.)] majjhimo khaṇḍo, dhammaṭṭhassa bhavissati.
segments.ja400:6.1: Cirampi bhakkho abhavissa, sace na vivademase;
segments.ja400:7.1: Yathāpi rājā nandeyya, rajjaṃ laddhāna khattiyo;
segments.ja400:8.1: Kathaṃ nu thalajo santo, udake macchaṃ parāmasi;
segments.ja400:8.3: Puṭṭho me samma akkhāhi, kathaṃ adhigataṃ tayā.
segments.ja400:9.3: Jīnā uddā vivādena, bhuñja māyāvi rohitaṃ.
segments.ja400:10.3: Dhammaṭṭhaṃ paṭidhāvanti, so hi nesaṃ vināyako;
segments.ja400:10.5: Dhanāpi tattha jīyanti, rājakoso pavaḍḍhatīti [ca vaḍḍhati (pī.)].
